title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale at Lion 3 Residence
description_en: Lion 3 Residence is positioned in one of the most developed areas of Tirana, part of a modern urban master plan, Bulevardi i Ri. Proximity to the future park and connection to the city's main network make this project ideal for living and investment. A residential tower where architecture and nature coexist in harmony. Green terraces create a dynamic facade and bring nature to every level of the building.
